traits.life_span.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Encelia (p. 122): perennial herbs or shrubs.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Encelia (p. 122): leaves alternate.

traits.receptacle.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Encelia (p. 122): receptacle with soft papery folded bracts that wrap the achenes and fall with them.

traits.receptacle_shape.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Encelia (p. 122): receptacle flattish.

traits.pappus.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Encelia (p. 122): pappus none or of 1-2 slender awns (E. farinosa has none).
